$comment: Whole-product review eval. seeded must raise every rule in must; clean must raise none of the rules in watch. Rules come from checks/structure.json and checks/consistency.json. The clean version must also have no P0-P2 finding from any check (checks/all.json), so a gate run on it passes the finding rule.

lenses.$comment: Scored by npm run eval:lenses after /designcritique:review on seeded.yaml or clean.yaml. The checks already find every seeded flaw, so the lenses are scored on what only judgement adds: proposals, verdicts and cited principles. clean: no P0/P1 from any reviewer and no cut or move proposals.
